rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Michelangelo ® (hybrid tea, Meilland before 1997)
rows.Bloom: Yellow, light yellow shading. Mild, lemon fragrance. 42 petals. Average diameter 5". Large, very full (41+ petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped, old-fashioned bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 16" to 5' (40 to 150cm). Width: 2' to 42" (60 to 105cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Heat tolerant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .

rows.Notes: Artist Michelangelo di Lodovico Buonarroti Simoni was born in Capres, Italy, 6 March 1475. He died in Rome, Italy, 18 February 1564.The first patent application for this variety was filed 28 Aug 2000. The current patent application is a continuation of that application.
